name: llm_summarise
description:
Summarises a piece of text in a few sentences, keeping names, figures and units as written (LLM tool, mode complete, model alias fast). Calls no tools; identical inputs are served from cache.
Returns: text (the summary) and stopped_by.
Inputs (* required): text* (the text to summarise; at most 20,000 characters); max_sentences (1-10; default 2). The summary is capped at 400 output tokens.
For classification into queues use llm_triage_ticket. An example LLM tool shipped disabled; an administrator enables it.
Example: {"text": "The central bank held its policy rate at 4.5% on Wednesday, citing sticky services inflation, and signalled two cuts later in the year.", "max_sentences": 1}

llm.system_prompt: You write short, faithful summaries. Keep names, numbers and units exactly as written.
llm.template:
Summarise the following text in at most {{input.max_sentences}} sentences.

{{input.text}}
